title: Giraffe wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='38' y='42' width='13' height='42' fill='#f6c445'/>
  <rect x='38' y='50' width='13' height='4' fill='#c98a1e'/>
  <rect x='38' y='60' width='13' height='4' fill='#c98a1e'/>
  <rect x='38' y='70' width='13' height='4' fill='#c98a1e'/>

  <ellipse cx='56' cy='82' rx='24' ry='14' fill='#f6c445'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='80' r='3.5' fill='#c98a1e'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='86' r='3' fill='#c98a1e'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='78' r='2.5' fill='#c98a1e'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='42' y='90' width='5' height='8' fill='#c98a1e'/>
  <rect x='64' y='90' width='5' height='8' fill='#c98a1e'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='34' rx='12' ry='11' fill='#f6c445'/>

  <ellipse cx='35' cy='39' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#f7d877'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='40' r='1.4' fill='#c98a1e'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='41' r='1.4' fill='#c98a1e'/>

  <circle cx='49.5' cy='20' r='2.5' fill='#e8a020'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='47' cy='32' r='2.2' fill='#5a3a12'/>
  <circle cx='47.7' cy='31.3' r='0.7' fill='#fff8e0'/>
  <!-- ear -->
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='30' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#e8a020'/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <polygon points='38,18 50,18 44,2' fill='#ff5ea8'/>
  <polygon points='41,13 47,13 44,6' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='2' r='3' fill='#4fd1ff'/>
  <circle cx='40.5' cy='16' r='1.2' fill='#4fd1ff'/>
  <circle cx='47.5' cy='16' r='1.2' fill='#4fd1ff'/>
</svg>
